ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution; approximately 85% low-intensity black pixels with 15% high-intensity white pixel clusters concentrated on distal edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant black central plane with discrete, high-contrast white circular blobs concentrated at the distal tips of both lobes and sparse scattering across the interior surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate 50-degree interior angle and sharp convergence point.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular saw-tooth serrations along the trailing edge, with significant protruding biological masses on the extreme left and right tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral concave curvature transitioning from the distal tips to the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed circular white rings and solid white focal points ranging from 5 to 25 pixels in diameter, primarily located on the outer third of both fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Short, white linear streaks with various orientations (diagonal and horizontal) visible on the medial portion of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large, irregular brown and white textured biological encrustations (barnacle clusters) protruding significantly from the left and right distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct horizontal white linear mark approximately midway up the right lobe's central vertical axis.
